outcome.technical: Comment-only edit beside STACK_BUDGET in tools/check-report-interactive.mjs (no share changed; STACK_BUDGET stays phone 0.45, tablet 0.3, laptop 0.4, desktop 0.25). (1) The rule is reworded to 'the largest stack the class's cells draw in either font, plus one row of headroom, over the class's screen height', and no longer claims each share leaves a row to spare: it says meeting the rule is not assumed, the measurement says which classes do, and the phone does not. (2) Each tightest cell now names the pass it was read in, re-measured over both reports with `node tools/check-report-interactive.mjs <report> 2>&1 | grep lm4` and all lm4 lines tabulated per class and pass: phone 27px at 844x390, both passes, either report, chip on or search typed (148/175); laptop 37px at 1024x768, both passes, demo-large, chip on (270/307); tablet 52px at 834x1194, chip/search, wide pass in either report and page font in acme-store only (306/358); desktop 56px at 1920x1080, wide-font pass only, demo-large (214/270; page font 182). (3) The phone row was measured in the wide font at 844x390 itself (Playwright probe outside the repo, Verdana override as the pass applies it, children of .sectools clustered by top), run twice 20s apart with identical figures: rows sit 8px apart, shortest item 19.4px, count 24px, row below the controls 31.1px, so one more row costs at least 27.4px and 32px holding the count. The comment states the phone has LESS than a row of headroom (27px under the cheapest row the bar can add), that a phone whose bar wraps one more row fails lm4, that this is a fact of the phone budget at 0.45, and that laptop/tablet/desktop each clear 32px. It says the check prints none of the row figures and gives the console expression they were read by. Verification: node --check exit 0; node tools/check-report-interactive.mjs examples/acme-store/acme-store-audit.html exit 0, 0 FAIL lines; tests/test__report_html.py 181/181, tests/test__report_usage.py 111/111, tests/test_render_report.py 315/315, each exit 0 read without a pipe. Dependants: docs/demo-large.html, docs/index.html, examples/acme-store/acme-store-audit.html - still correct, they are inputs the check reads and a comment changes no assertion; plugins/audit/scripts/report/_report_html.py, report-css/controls.css, forced-colors.css, shell.css - still correct, they render what lm4 measures and nothing in them changed; tests/test__report_html.py - still correct, 181/181 after the edit.
outcome.descriptive: STACK_BUDGET's basis now claims only what its figures show: the phone's 27px is under one wide-font row, stated as a fact of its budget, and each tightest cell names its pass.
